The structure of Li14Cr3Sb2O18 (reduced formula Li7Cr3SbO9) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 37 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies Cr in a tetrahedral environment with four O neighbors and Li in both 4- and 5-coordinate O environments. O-centered octahedral coordination is observed, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cr tetrahedra and O octahedra, edge-sharing between O octahedra, and corner-sharing between Cr tetrahedra and 4-vertex Li polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 37 sites.
